title: Initial spring deformations
description: Essential: Correctly states both initial deformations: spring k₂ compressed by mg/k₂ and spring k₁ stretched by 2mg/k₁.

title: Pulley descent distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance the pulley descends as 6mg/k₁.

title: Height difference A-B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the final height difference between A and B as 12mg/k₁.

title: Force equilibrium for B
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to object B to relate weight, spring force, and tension.

title: Force equilibrium for pulley
description: Important: Applies force balance to the movable pulley, relating rope tension to the force in spring k₁.

title: Condition for C lifting
description: Important: Identifies that object C is about to leave the ground when the spring k₂ force equals C's weight.

title: Kinematic displacement relations
description: Important: Correctly relates the displacements of the pulley, object A, and object B using rope constraints.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in spring force (compression vs. elongation) or misassigns displacement directions.

title: Tension confusion
description: Pitfall: Assumes tension is constant or incorrectly relates tensions in different stages of the process.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Includes a check that all final expressions have correct units (length).
